title: Sticks 'n' Stones
description: A simple mod that adds ores like Mechium and Vodite, slanted tiles ( Hashes ), and more.
body:
This is a mod that adds a few cool building blocks ands a few ores. Currently this is very unfinished but I just want some feedback right now.

This mod adds Mechium which is a purple metal found in ores that can be used for multiple decorative blocks and armor. That armor is called Mechium Thornic Armor which when hit, its hurts the mob/player back. Some of the decorative blocks are called Hashes. They are basically a slanted tile design made in multiple materials. This also adds a block called Ferronite which drops iron nuggets. In the end, you can find Vodite Ore which can be used to make to make a Slurp Juice.
